octabit.title: Exploring Microcode CPU Instructions with RISC 8-Bit Breadboard Computer
octabit.abstract: A documented RISC-style 8-bit breadboard computer built with transistor and TTL logic, a discrete arithmetic logic unit, Arduino-managed microcode, four-bit opcode and address fields, and a four-digit seven-segment output. The public record connects the implementation, schematics, hardware documentation, and published paper.

emoji_transnetv1.title: Emoji Contextual Translator
emoji_transnetv1.abstract: An archived T5 fine-tuning experiment that translates emoji-rich sentences into plain-English descriptions and includes inference and ROUGE evaluation scripts.

reproducibility.summary: The repository documents dependencies, inference, training, and ROUGE evaluation, but does not provide a complete version-pinned reproduction environment.

falcon.title: Falcon High-Altitude Commit Engine
falcon.abstract: A completed automation experiment that used Git plumbing to produce a deliberately large repository history and contribution-graph pattern. It is preserved as an experimental artifact, not an active research claim.

reproducibility.summary: The repository preserves the resulting history and a high-level implementation description, but no supported reproduction protocol is published.

monodiffuse.title: Native Binary-Weight Training Outperforms Zero-Shot Sign Projection in MNIST Diffusion
monodiffuse.abstract: A controlled study of one-bit-weight diffusion training that separates binary representational limits from post-training projection failure using matched residual U-Net experiments, repeated seeds, controls, hashes, and runnable artifacts.

liveDemos.name: Diffuino Live
liveDemos.description: Run the public MNIST diffusion demonstration backed by released ONNX and binary-network model artifacts.

reproducibility.summary: The repository provides exact commands, controls, three-seed artifacts, hashes, publication packaging, and a versioned citation record.

citation.text: Bhattacharya, Chakraborty, and Gazi. Native Binary-Weight Training Outperforms Zero-Shot Sign Projection in MNIST Diffusion. MonoDiffuse Technical Report 2026-01 (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23424654

search.elixpo.title: A Three-Layer Caching Architecture for Low-Latency LLM Web Search on Commodity CPU Hardware
search.elixpo.abstract: OreoLook presents a three-layer cache for session context, semantically equivalent queries, and URL embeddings in an open LLM answer engine operating on commodity CPU infrastructure.

liveDemos.name: OreoLook
liveDemos.description: Run cited web research and structured report generation through the public OreoLook demonstration.

reproducibility.summary: The implementation, interactive Space, paper, and evaluation dataset are public; the arXiv record states that code availability is by request, so the complete paper-specific reproduction path is not yet documented.

citation.text: Bhattacharya and Gazi. A Three-Layer Caching Architecture for Low-Latency LLM Web Search on Commodity CPU Hardware. arXiv:2609.05463 (2026).

qfabric.title: QFabric: Contract-Driven Cross-Domain Task Recovery
qfabric.abstract: QFabric studies empirical timing-contract recovery across Linux and RTOS domains on Arduino UNO Q, with safe-boundary migration, rollback, and replayable decisions.

licenses.artifact: unpublished manuscript, original figures, tables, and testbed photograph

reproducibility.summary: The repository includes raw and processed evidence, staged audits, reproducible paper tables and figures, package artifacts, checksum manifests, and hardware-independent verification commands.

citation.text: Bhattacharya and Chakraborty. QFabric: Contract-Driven Cross-Domain Task Recovery, v1.0.2 (2026).

wozformer.title: WozFormer: Language-Model Inference on Constrained 6502 Hardware
wozformer.abstract: An active investigation of compact transformer, retrieval, recurrent, and hyperdimensional architectures for language-model inference on a 1 MHz 6502 with tightly constrained SRAM and EEPROM. The public record includes progressive notebooks, model exports, reference implementations, hardware work, empirical findings, and an in-progress manuscript.

artifacts.label: WozFormer research implementation and reproducibility artifacts

licenses.artifact: source code and repository research artifacts

reproducibility.summary: The repository publishes progressive notebooks, implementation code, exported models, reference paths, empirical findings, and hardware documentation. The complete 6502 hardware result and formal paper release are still in progress.
